infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Basha Vhara Koto needs camera access to capture photos for your listing and KYC (identity verification).
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Basha Vhara Koto needs photo library access to upload images for your listing and profile.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Basha Vhara Koto needs your location to show nearby rental listings.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Basha Vhara Koto uses Face ID to securely unlock the app.
